alt: An open iPhone Duo foldable held in a hand, showing a bright white horizontal crack line running across the inner display right at the hinge point, with Chinese iOS widgets visible around it
story: Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo — its first-ever foldable, launched October 23, 2026 — has inner displays cracking along the hinge within hours of unboxing; iFixit's teardown identified a hidden flaw where a display cable crosses a central support bar under the screen, and Samsung immediately launched global billboards saying 'Welcome to Foldables' and 'folding since 2019.'
why_funny: Apple spent years refusing to make a foldable until it got it right, while Samsung built seven generations of them — and Apple's very first attempt cracked before most users had opened it twice.
